description: This file defines the AppConfigDataClient class in the Aws\AppConfigData namespace, used for interacting with the AWS AppConfig Data service. It extends the AwsClient class and declares methods for fetching and managing configuration data asynchronously and synchronously.

classes.name: AppConfigDataClient
classes.description: Client class to interact with AWS AppConfig Data service, providing methods to retrieve and manage configuration data.

methods.name: getLatestConfiguration
methods.description: Fetches the latest configuration data synchronously.

methods.name: getLatestConfigurationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches the latest configuration data.
